envelope.description: Validate accountable completion at one accepted checkpoint

body.title: Validate accountable completion at one accepted checkpoint
body.summary: Add completion-types.ts and completion-assessment.ts with exact sc5 assessment/receipt types and fail-closed coverage checks. Consume verified sc2/sc4 state and current approved pins/party records; do not execute reviewers or accept new final deltas.
acceptanceChecks: Exact CompletionAssessmentV1 and ReviewCompletionReceiptV1 shapes match approved sc5.
Every required task/check/design/change/criterion/impact row and latest selected block disposition is checked against pinned basis and trusted receipt closure.
Missing/pending/unverified rows, unfinished blocks or outstanding work return incomplete; unsupported satisfaction/applicability refuses.
Unplanned changed scope remains required; conflicting expectations or unknown/same author-reviewer return conflict without weakening requirements.
Stale source/BUILD/contract/policy compatibility returns stale with reasons; findings can form accountable completed WARN/BLOCK.

tests.name: Completion validates every required row block evidence and independent party
Completion rejects stale conflicting and unsupported coverage without canonical writes
